title: SecondaryObservabilityVolumeAndSampledCoverageSchemaV2
description: Corrected spatial observability specification replacing ungrounded continuous zero-blind-pocket claims with bounded sampled-observability criteria, resolving polygon-to-grid lateral rail mismatches and purging unvoxelized voxel terminology.

zone_polygon.name: ZONE_POLYGON
zone_polygon.definition: The 2D horizontal bounding polygon of the secondary cross-aisle corridor in facility local coordinates.
zone_polygon.facility_datum_origin: Cross-aisle entrance threshold junction (X = 30.0 m, Y = 0.0 m, Z = 0.0 m)

measurement_grid.name: MEASUREMENT_GRID
measurement_grid.definition: The discrete spatial test array used to evaluate sensor resolution and line-of-sight across depth, width, and height.
measurement_grid.lateral_mismatch_audit: The full facility corridor width is 3.5 m (Y in [-1.75, +1.75] m), whereas the discrete lateral rails span 2.4 m (Y in [-1.2, +1.2] m). The lateral margin zones (|Y| in [1.2, 1.75] m, total area 22.0 m^2) represent unsampled clearance strips adjacent to warehouse pallet racking.

observability_sample_points.name: OBSERVABILITY_SAMPLE_POINTS
observability_sample_points.definition: The exact set of 36 discrete 3D spatial points (x_i, y_j, z_k) at which the standardized physical target (SPMT-01 mannequin) is placed for optical resolution and occlusion testing.
observability_sample_points.voxel_terminology_purge: The term 'voxel' is purged. A voxel requires a defined finite 3D bounding box (dx, dy, dz) and occupancy integration. The 36 test locations are point evaluations, designated OBSERVABILITY_SAMPLE_POINTS.

observed_area.name: OBSERVED_AREA
observed_area.definition: The horizontal projection of the corridor where optical line-of-sight and spatial resolution have been verified.
observed_area.epistemic_status: SAMPLED_POINT_OBSERVED (Directly verified at discrete sample points only)

unobserved_area.name: UNOBSERVED_AREA
unobserved_area.definition: Corridor floor area outside the direct line-of-sight rays or beyond the sampled rails, including the 0.55 m lateral rack clearance margins (|Y| in [1.2, 1.75] m).

critical_obstruction_area.name: CRITICAL_OBSTRUCTION_AREA
critical_obstruction_area.definition: Projected continuous floor area within the dynamic vehicle diversion trajectory corridor occluded by permanent facility structural elements (columns, building support pillars, electrical cabinets).
critical_obstruction_area.mathematical_limitation: CRITICAL_OBSTRUCTION_AREA = 0.0 m^2 CANNOT be mathematically deduced from 36 discrete point evaluations alone. Point sampling verifies only that the 36 specific line-of-sight paths are unoccluded.
critical_obstruction_area.authoritative_acceptance_target: SAMPLED_POINT_OBSERVABILITY == 36/36 (100%) AND SURVEYED_PERMANENT_OBSTRUCTIONS == 0 within primary dynamic envelope

gate_c4_acceptance_criteria.continuous_coverage_limitation_statement: Passing the 36-point grid sweep establishes SAMPLED_POINT_OBSERVABILITY. It does NOT prove continuous volumetric zero-blindness across the unmonitored lateral margins (|Y| > 1.2 m). Full continuous coverage remains UNVERIFIED_BOUNDED_INTERPOLATION pending continuous LiDAR surface scanning.
